create_VAE_model: create a VAE model with a discrete domain, latent dimensions, and custom optimizer
build_decoder_output_model: build a Keras decoder output model for a discrete domain with masking support
sample_from_prior: sample latent vectors from a normal prior distribution with configurable mean and stddev
fit_VAE_model: fit a VAE model on discrete structure sequences with optional sample weights
compute_log_probability: compute log probabilities of sequences via importance sampling over posterior samples
